title: Timeline with Icon Markers
description: A timeline of pull request events: the list sets $marker to icon with a $markerSize larger than one line, a guide joins the chips, $itemGap brings each time closer to its title, and the last event shows a check tinted with the success color. A comment is a closed ListDisclosure with its own surface, so the guide runs behind the card, and its ListDisclosureButton opens Prose content. Use it for a history of events with different kinds, such as an activity feed or an audit log.
